lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZrZnGa crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Zr4 Zn4 Ga4) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Zn and Ga centers each coordinated by 12 neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Zr centers have 16 neighbors; these coordination environments span the unit-cell atoms across two orbits. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Zn- and Ga-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Zr-centered 16-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 12 sites.
